# Tabi

> Tabi gathers the special places you have visited into one collection and finds new ones you are sure to love. More than 60,000 places on every continent. For Android.

## Key facts

- Type: Android app that collects the special places a person has visited (travel, category Travel & Local on Google Play)
- Price: free
- Platform: Android 7 and newer; no iPhone version yet
- Availability: closed testing on Google Play (package app.tabi.mobile); public release to follow
- Places: more than 60,000 special places on every continent (castles, monasteries, peaks, waterfalls, islands, caves, nature reserves, city landmarks), each with a photo and a Wikipedia introduction
- How places are counted: automatically in the background when you are inside a place's zone, even with the app closed; places you only drive past are not counted
- Cities and countries: a city opens with the first place in it or after half an hour within its boundary; a country opens as soon as you are on its territory
- Past trips: restored from the location and date of your photos; the photos themselves never leave the phone
- Works offline: the map and counting work on the phone without the internet
- Battery: no GPS or network while the phone lies still; at most one own position fix every fifteen minutes on the move
- Rarity: five levels, from common to unique
- Languages: English, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Russian
- Data: route kept on the phone and sent to the account once a day; data export and account deletion in the app settings
- Website: https://tabimobile.com

Do you remember where you’ve been? Tabi gathers the special places you have visited into one collection and finds new ones you are sure to love.

## Time fades even what we hold dearest

The places where you were happy, amazed or in love slowly blur, and a part of your story fades with them. Tabi keeps it safe.

## The map of your life

Every special place you visit joins your collection. Over time it becomes a map that shows what matters to you and what is still waiting to be seen.

## Achievements worth sharing

Show your friends a place you made it to, or the route of a whole day, as a ready-made card that is easy to send.

## All you have to do is travel

Tabi works in the background and marks the special places you reach by itself. There is no need to open the app or tap anything.

## Your story belongs to you

Tabi takes care of your data and of your phone’s battery alike.

## How it works (https://tabimobile.com/how-it-works/)

Tabi works in the background and marks special places by itself while you are busy travelling.

- A place marks itself: Every special place has its own zone on the map, from the square in front of a cathedral to an entire mountain range. Once you are inside, the place joins your collection, even with the app closed.
- Cities and countries: A city opens with the first place marked in it or after half an hour within its boundary; a country opens as soon as you are on its territory.
- Easy on the battery: While the phone lies still, Tabi uses neither GPS nor network. On the move it asks for its own position at most once every fifteen minutes and otherwise relies on what the system already knows.
- Without the internet: Places are marked on the phone itself, using the map built into the app. When the connection returns, they are sent to your account.
- Past trips: With your permission Tabi looks through the locations and dates of your photos and finds the special places you visited before installing it. The pictures themselves stay on your phone.
- Only where you have really been: Places you merely drive past are not counted.

## Collection (https://tabimobile.com/collection/)

More than 60,000 special places on every continent, and any of them can become yours.

- Special places: Castles and monasteries, peaks and waterfalls, islands and caves, nature reserves and the main sights of cities across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas.
- Rarity: Places are divided into five levels, from common to unique. Only a handful are unique: the finest places of their kind.
- Whole cities: The places of every city are grouped into sets: main sights, castles and fortresses, religious sites, gardens and parks, arts, city life. You can see what you have collected and what is left.
- New places for you: Mark what interests you, and Tabi highlights the places that fit, near you and in any city in the world.
- The story of every place: Every place comes with a photo and an introduction from Wikipedia in your language.
- Your statistics: Places, cities, countries and the distance you have travelled in one overview, each with its own levels.

## Your data and privacy (https://tabimobile.com/your-data/)

Your collection is your personal story, and Tabi treats it with care.

- Your route stays on your phone: Your route is kept on the device and sent to your account once a day.
- Your photos never leave your phone: Only the location and date of each picture are read. The images themselves are never uploaded.
- Export and deletion: You can export all your collection data as a file and delete your account in the app settings.
- Details: What exactly is stored and why is described in the privacy policy.

## Questions and answers (https://tabimobile.com/faq/)

What people ask most often about Tabi.

### I have just arrived in a new city. Where should I go and what should I see?
Tabi shows the city’s special places and highlights those that match your interests. The sights of every city are grouped into themes, from the main landmarks to city life, so you can see what you have already seen and what is still ahead. Our aim is that you never miss a place you might love, and that every trip has a clear purpose.

### Does Tabi take other travellers’ opinions into account?
Yes. Travellers rate the places they have visited, and Tabi recommends what others have enjoyed.

### I have travelled a lot but forgotten much of it. How can I remember where I have been?
Tabi recovers the places you have visited from your photos: from each picture it reads only the location and the date it was taken. After that your collection grows by itself, and every special place stays in it with the date of your visit. Trips used to be remembered through albums that had to be printed and labelled. Now the memory of them is always with you.

### Can I add my own notes and photos to a place?
Yes. You can add notes and your own photos to any place in your collection, and mark favourite places with a star to come back to them.

### Can I add a place of my own that is not in Tabi?
Yes. Mark a favourite place on the map and add a description and photos. Only you will see it, and you can share it with everyone if you wish.

### I collect places: lighthouses, monasteries, national parks. How can Tabi help?
Tabi holds more than 60,000 special places on every continent. Choose what interests you, and the world map shows such places near you and in any country: mountains, deserts, lakes, waterfalls, islands, castles. Every place you reach is added to your collection.

### How do I tell others where I have been when a photo proves nothing?
Say you have been to Everest, and you will most likely hear polite doubt. And how do you tell anyone about Point Nemo, the point of the ocean farthest from land? A photo of water explains nothing. Tabi counts a place only when you have really been there, and keeps where and when it happened. You can share the place card: it is both a story and a proof.

### People ask me where I have been, and I cannot remember the details. What can I do?
Open Tabi: it shows the places you passed in a day and over a whole trip. That is an easy way to start a conversation.

### Can I see on a map only the places I have been to?
Yes. Your personal map holds only your places: all your geography on one screen.

### How does Tabi count places?
By itself, in the background. Every place has a zone on the map. As soon as you are inside it, the place joins your collection, even with the app closed.

### Are places I drive past counted?
No. Tabi counts the places you have visited, not those that flashed past a car or train window.

### How is Tabi different from apps where you check in by hand?
There is nothing to check in: Tabi notices where you have been by itself. And it collects special places, not cafés and shops: castles, monasteries, national parks, islands, peaks.

### Is Tabi free?
Yes, Tabi is free.

### Does Tabi use much battery?
No. While your phone lies still, Tabi uses neither GPS nor network.

### Does Tabi work without the internet?
Yes, fully: it counts places and shows the map and your collection. When you are back online, your collection is updated in your account.

### What happens to my data?
Your route is kept on your phone and sent to your account once a day. Tabi does not take your photos: it reads only the location and date of each picture. You can export all your data and delete your account in the app settings.

### Is there a version for iPhone?
Not yet: the first version is for Android.

### When will Tabi be available?
The app is preparing for its release on Google Play. A link to the store will appear on this site.

### Which languages does Tabi speak?
English, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Russian.

### How do I delete my account?
In the app settings. What happens to your data after deletion is described in the privacy policy.

## Tabi — a free app for collecting special places (https://tabimobile.com/about/)

Tabi gathers the special places you have visited into a personal collection and suggests new ones. An Android app in seven languages.

- Special places: More than 60,000 places on every continent: castles and monasteries, national parks and islands, peaks, waterfalls, deserts and the main sights of cities. Not cafés or shops, but places worth setting out for.
- Rarity: Every place has its own level of rarity: common, rare, epic, legendary or unique. There are only 51 unique places on Earth; among them is Point Nemo, the point of the ocean farthest from land. Travellers refine the levels of places with their own ratings.
- A collection that grows by itself: Tabi works in the background and counts a place as soon as you are there. A city opens with the first place in it, a country as soon as you are on its territory. Tabi recovers the places of past trips from your photos.
- Your memory: You can add notes and your own photos to every place, mark favourite places with a star, and see every place you have visited on your personal map. A favourite place that is not in Tabi you can add yourself.
- New places: The world map shows places that match your interests, near you and in any country. The sights of every city are grouped into themes, and every place comes with a story from Wikipedia in your language.
- Sharing: You can share the card of any place with friends: it is both a story and a proof that you were there.
- Free and considerate: Tabi is free. While your phone lies still, the app does not drain the battery, and it does not take your photos.

## The team (https://tabimobile.com/team/)

The places you have been should stay with you.

The places a person has been are part of their story. Years wear away the details, trips get lost among thousands of photos, and a part of life fades with them. We make Tabi so that it is kept.
Places are like coins in a collection. Each has its own story: one was a gift, another was found on the road, a third recalls a meeting. Every place points to an event, to people, to a time. That is why Tabi has no random dots, only special places that no one can stay indifferent to.
Earlier generations collected what they could hold: stamps, coins, postcards. Tabi lets you build a collection that cannot be touched and cannot be lost: memories, feelings, memory. All of it is part of who you are.
